a.lede: The US Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) warned federal agencies that attackers are now exploiting a recently patched critical Cisco Expressway vulnerability in the wild. [...]
a.title: CISA flags critical Cisco RCE flaw as actively exploited in attacks

b.lede: Eclypsium's November InfraTrust report warns that most infrastructure security advisories addressing exploited vulnerabilities over the past month involve flaws in third-party software bundled into products rather than code developed by the vendors themselves. [...]
b.title: InfraTrust warns of exploited supply chain flaws in network appliances
